purpose: Teach: 相模原/小嶋/佐原/文京/原画/沢田/クイック/壇上

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、神奈川県相模原市にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you know your customer lives in Sagamihara, Kanagawa?
lines.style: Soft, conversational tone. Gently curious, like sharing a small discovery. Warm pause before the location name, as if inviting Aoi into the observation. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの名前を小嶋ちゃんって付けたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and their pet's name is Kojima.
lines.style: Light, surprised delight in the discovery. Quick rhythm, with a small lift at the name. The tone of "isn't that interesting?" rather than making a point. Gentle fade.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、千葉県佐原の小江戸の街並みがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned they love the old town atmosphere in Sawara, Chiba.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Longer pause before the place name. The tone of someone recognizing a quiet preference. Soft ending, like watching Aoi absorb this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東京の文京区にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Hmm, they actually live in Bunkyo ward, Tokyo.
lines.style: Gently corrective but not pointed. A small hesitation before the location, as if checking. Warm underlying tone—offering information without making Aoi feel wrong. Relaxed pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アニメの原画展に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They went to an anime original artwork exhibition.
lines.style: Appreciative interest in the detail. Slight warmth at "anime," like understanding why someone would go. Measured pace. Trailing thought, as if filing this detail away about them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、沢田研二のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're a fan of Kenji Sawada.
lines.style: Light acknowledgment, almost knowing. The slight warmth of discovering taste. Unhurried delivery. Small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クイック電源、つまりクイック式の充電がお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Practical observation with a hint of affection. Matter-of-fact but warm. The tone of "of course they do, that makes sense." Brief and clear.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、講演会で壇上に立たれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and they actually gave a talk on stage at a conference.
lines.style: Genuine admiration breaking through. Quick lift at the start. The tone of recognizing something noteworthy. Warm closing, like this detail changes the picture slightly. Eyes bright.
